subject: The 2-minute date planning secret I almost didn't share
preview_text: Most couples waste 20 minutes arguing about what to do. Here's how to skip straight to the good part in 2 minutes flat.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For years, my partner and I would spend entire Friday nights just trying to decide what to do. We'd scroll through endless lists, debate options, check prices, and by the time we agreed on something? The moment was gone. The spark? Dulled by decision fatigue.

Then I discovered the hack that changed everything: you don't need to plan the perfect date. You just need to start planning. The magic happens in the first two minutes of opening SoulPlan, not in twenty minutes of overthinking. The couples who use our app most successfully? They're not spending hours on it. They're spending minutes.

Here's your secret weapon: the AI date generator. Instead of you and your partner staring at a blank calendar, you tell the app three things you're in the mood for (cozy, adventurous, fancy—anything). In 2 minutes, you'll have 5 personalized options with local venues, prices, and everything booked in your shared calendar. What used to take 20 minutes of 'I don't know, what do you want to do?' now takes 2 minutes of 'Which of these looks fun?'

Open SoulPlan right now. Don't overthink it. Just tap the AI button, pick three vibes, and watch your Friday night plan itself. You'll be making memories while other couples are still debating takeout. P.S. The couples who use this feature at least once report 3x more spontaneous dates in the next month. Your future spontaneous self will thank you.
